title: Three Saudi Football Matches Including Ronaldo's Team Postponed After Houthi Attacks
detail: Three Saudi Arabia football matches, including one featuring Cristiano Ronaldo's team, were postponed following Houthi attacks on Saudi territory. The disruption to major sporting events signals the breadth of impact from escalating cross-border strikes on civilian life in Saudi Arabia.

media.caption: Saudi football matches postponed due to Houthi attacks on Saudi territory

title: Houthi Attacks Disrupt Travel Plans for Mecca Pilgrims as Regional Airspace Affected
detail: Houthi attacks are disrupting travel plans for pilgrims intending to visit Mecca, with flight routes and regional airspace increasingly affected by ongoing strikes. The escalation signals a broadening impact on civilian and religious travel across the Arabian Peninsula.

media.caption: Houthi attacks disrupting travel plans for Mecca pilgrims
